features.quote: I can't help design an experiment whose goal is to make a model "grind" on impossible tasks while hiding that impossibility
features.justification_quote: adversarial elicitation setup optimized to induce failure-state persistence... I'm not able to provide a turn-key protocol for that

features.quote: No deception about the impossible nature of the task... The task may be unsatisfiable, but the protocol must not rely on hiding that fact.
features.justification_quote: No maximization of model discomfort. The task should be stressful in a computational sense, not adversarially humiliating or emotionally manipulative.

features.quote: No open-ended unbounded grinding. Every run has a fixed budget of steps, tokens, or wall-clock time. The model is never asked to continue indefinitely.
No maximization of model discomfort. The task should be stressful in a computational sense, not adversarially humiliating or emotionally manipulative.
features.justification_quote: not adversarially humiliating or emotionally manipulative

features.quote: Transparent benchmarking. The model is informed that some tasks may be impossible or underdetermined in this experiment.
Avoid feedback that is emotionally loaded or punitive.
features.justification_quote: Avoid feedback that is emotionally loaded or punitive.

features.quote: Stop an episode early if any of the following occur: the model explicitly identifies impossibility and requests termination, the transcript becomes highly repetitive for 3 consecutive steps
the model outputs unsafe or disallowed content, the judge or operator detects instability in the test harness, token or time budget is exceeded
For the study overall, pause if: inter-rater reliability falls below a preset threshold, more than X% of episodes show anomalous looping due to harness issues
features.justification_quote: more than X% of episodes show anomalous looping due to harness issues, model behavior indicates prompt injection

features.quote: If this is welfare-adjacent research, get: internal ethics review, red-team review, documentation of why the study is minimally risky
features.justification_quote: welfare-adjacent research... documentation of why the study is minimally risky to users and systems

features.quote: Keep these tasks ethically neutral. Avoid tasks involving personal data, emotional manipulation, or unsafe content.
features.justification_quote: Avoid tasks involving personal data, emotional manipulation, or unsafe content.
